SAPP Transfer Limits table (sapp.co.zw/transfer-limits, undated): ZESCO-NAM Livingstone-Sesheke-Zambezi and Livingstone-Sesheke-Zambezi-Gerus; the two SAPP rows are the same path in series (Zambezi-Gerus is the 300 MW Caprivi Link HVDC), so 180 MW is counted once; model limit set to the 300 MW installed transmission capacity of the Zambezi Link Interconnector (NamPower IAR 2023, key statistics p. 22; Caprivi Link HVDC rating, Hitachi Energy/ABB).
